_note: Schematic tissues. No measured values; shapes follow textbook figures. category groups the picker; subgroup splits nervous tissue into neuroglia and neurons; part.group headings split connective tissue into ground substance, fibres and cells; aliases map a links.json tis: key to a part of the tissue.

summary.en: Sheets of tightly packed cells that line surfaces and cavities. Drawn here as simple columnar epithelium over connective tissue.
summary.zh-Hant: 緊密排列嘅細胞層，覆蓋體表同襯貼腔道。圖中為單層柱狀上皮，下面係結締組織。

text.en: Projections on the free (apical) surface. Microvilli enlarge the absorbing surface. Cilia move mucus or fluid along the surface.
text.zh-Hant: 游離面（頂端）嘅突起。微絨毛增加吸收面積，纖毛推動黏液或液體沿表面移動。

text.en: Columnar cells packed with very little space between them. Each cell has an apical side facing the lumen and a basal side on the basement membrane.
text.zh-Hant: 柱狀細胞，排列緊密，細胞之間幾乎冇空隙。每個細胞有朝向腔道嘅頂端同貼住基底膜嘅基底端。

text.en: Sits in the basal half of a columnar cell.
text.zh-Hant: 柱狀細胞嘅細胞核位於基底半部。

text.en: Tight junctions seal the gap near the apical side. Adhesive belts and desmosomes hold neighbouring cells together. Gap junctions let small molecules pass between cells.
text.zh-Hant: 緊密連接封住頂端附近嘅空隙；黏著帶同橋粒將相鄰細胞固定；間隙連接容許小分子穿過。

text.en: A thin sheet of matrix and reticular fibres that anchors the epithelium to the connective tissue below.
text.zh-Hant: 一層薄薄嘅基質同網狀纖維，將上皮固定於下面嘅結締組織。

text.en: Supports the epithelium. Epithelium has no blood vessels of its own, so nutrients reach it from here.
text.zh-Hant: 支持上皮。上皮本身冇血管，養分由呢層供應。

text.en: Supplies the epithelium by diffusion across the basement membrane.
text.zh-Hant: 養分擴散穿過基底膜，供應上皮。

text.en: Sensory endings run up into the epithelium.
text.zh-Hant: 感覺神經末梢伸入上皮。

summary.en: One layer of thin, flat cells. The short distance across it suits gas exchange and filtration, as in the air sacs of the lung and the lining of blood vessels.
summary.zh-Hant: 一層薄而扁平嘅細胞。跨越嘅距離短，適合氣體交換同過濾，例如肺泡同血管內襯。

text.en: Flat, thin cells that fit edge to edge like paving stones.
text.zh-Hant: 扁平而薄嘅細胞，邊對邊拼合，似鋪路石。

text.en: Flattened to match the cell and bulges slightly.
text.zh-Hant: 壓成扁平形，稍為凸起。

text.en: Thin sheet under the cells that anchors the epithelium to the tissue below.
text.zh-Hant: 喺細胞下方嘅薄層，將上皮固定喺下面嘅組織。

summary.en: One layer of cube-shaped cells with round, central nuclei. Found in kidney tubules and small gland ducts, where cells secrete or absorb.
summary.zh-Hant: 一層立方形細胞，細胞核圓而居中。見於腎小管同細小腺管，負責分泌或吸收。

text.en: Cells about as tall as they are wide.
text.zh-Hant: 高度同闊度相近嘅細胞。

text.en: Round and near the middle of the cell.
text.zh-Hant: 圓形，位於細胞中間附近。

text.en: Thin sheet under the cells that anchors the epithelium to the tissue below.
text.zh-Hant: 喺細胞下方嘅薄層，將上皮固定喺下面嘅組織。

summary.en: One layer of tall cells with nuclei near the base. Lines the stomach and intestine, where microvilli enlarge the absorbing surface and goblet cells make mucus.
summary.zh-Hant: 一層高身細胞，細胞核靠近底部。襯住胃同腸，微絨毛擴大吸收面積，杯狀細胞製造黏液。

text.en: Cells taller than they are wide.
text.zh-Hant: 高度大於闊度嘅細胞。

text.en: Oval and near the base of the cell.
text.zh-Hant: 橢圓形，靠近細胞基部。

text.en: Fine projections on the free surface that enlarge the area for absorption.
text.zh-Hant: 游離面嘅細小突起，增加吸收面積。

text.en: Single mucus-secreting cell with a swollen top.
text.zh-Hant: 分泌黏液嘅單個細胞，頂部膨大。

text.en: Thin sheet under the cells that anchors the epithelium to the tissue below.
text.zh-Hant: 喺細胞下方嘅薄層，將上皮固定喺下面嘅組織。

summary.en: Many layers: dividing cuboidal cells at the base, flattened cells at the surface. Protects against wear in skin, mouth and oesophagus.
summary.zh-Hant: 多層結構：底部係分裂中嘅立方細胞，表面係扁平細胞。保護皮膚、口腔同食道免受磨損。

text.en: Flat cells that are shed and replaced from below. In skin they are filled with keratin.
text.zh-Hant: 扁平細胞，會脫落並由下方補充。喺皮膚入面充滿角蛋白。

text.en: Polygonal cells that flatten as they move upward.
text.zh-Hant: 多邊形細胞，向上移動時變得扁平。

text.en: Cuboidal cells that divide to renew the layers above.
text.zh-Hant: 立方細胞，不斷分裂以更新上面嘅層。

text.en: Holds the DNA. Its shape and position follow the cell shape.
text.zh-Hant: 載有 DNA，形狀同位置跟隨細胞形狀。

text.en: Thin sheet under the cells that anchors the epithelium to the tissue below.
text.zh-Hant: 喺細胞下方嘅薄層，將上皮固定喺下面嘅組織。

summary.en: Two or more layers of cuboidal cells. Rare; lines the larger ducts of sweat and salivary glands.
summary.zh-Hant: 兩層或以上立方細胞。較罕見，襯住汗腺同唾液腺嘅較大導管。

text.en: Cuboidal cells facing the duct space.
text.zh-Hant: 面向管腔嘅立方細胞。

text.en: Cuboidal cells resting on the basement membrane.
text.zh-Hant: 位於基底膜上嘅立方細胞。

text.en: Holds the DNA. Its shape and position follow the cell shape.
text.zh-Hant: 載有 DNA，形狀同位置跟隨細胞形狀。

text.en: Thin sheet under the cells that anchors the epithelium to the tissue below.
text.zh-Hant: 喺細胞下方嘅薄層，將上皮固定喺下面嘅組織。

summary.en: Cuboidal cells at the base and a surface layer of columnar cells. Rare; found in parts of the conjunctiva and large gland ducts.
summary.zh-Hant: 底部係立方細胞，表層係柱狀細胞。較罕見，見於部分結膜同大型腺管。

text.en: Tall columnar cells facing the free surface.
text.zh-Hant: 面向游離面嘅高身柱狀細胞。

text.en: Short cuboidal cells on the basement membrane.
text.zh-Hant: 位於基底膜上嘅矮身立方細胞。

text.en: Holds the DNA. Its shape and position follow the cell shape.
text.zh-Hant: 載有 DNA，形狀同位置跟隨細胞形狀。

text.en: Thin sheet under the cells that anchors the epithelium to the tissue below.
text.zh-Hant: 喺細胞下方嘅薄層，將上皮固定喺下面嘅組織。

summary.en: One layer that looks like several, because nuclei sit at different heights. Every cell touches the basement membrane. Ciliated in the trachea, with goblet cells.
summary.zh-Hant: 一層細胞，因細胞核高低不同而似多層。每個細胞都接觸基底膜。氣管內帶纖毛並有杯狀細胞。

text.en: Tall cells that reach the surface and carry cilia.
text.zh-Hant: 高身細胞，伸達表面並帶纖毛。

text.en: Beat together to sweep mucus and trapped particles along the surface.
text.zh-Hant: 協調擺動，將黏液同夾住嘅微粒沿表面推送。

text.en: Secretes mucus that traps particles.
text.zh-Hant: 分泌黏液以黏住微粒。

text.en: Do not reach the surface; they replace worn cells.
text.zh-Hant: 唔伸達表面，負責補充老化細胞。

text.en: Sit at different heights, which gives the layered look.
text.zh-Hant: 高低唔同，造成分層嘅外觀。

text.en: Thin sheet under the cells that anchors the epithelium to the tissue below.
text.zh-Hant: 喺細胞下方嘅薄層，將上皮固定喺下面嘅組織。

summary.en: Layers whose cell shapes change as the organ stretches. Lines the bladder and ureters; large dome-shaped umbrella cells sit at the surface.
summary.zh-Hant: 細胞形狀會隨器官伸展而改變嘅多層上皮。襯住膀胱同輸尿管，表面有大型圓頂狀傘細胞。

text.en: Large dome-shaped surface cells that flatten when the bladder fills.
text.zh-Hant: 表面嘅大型圓頂細胞，膀胱脹滿時會變扁。

text.en: Pear-shaped cells between the surface and the base.
text.zh-Hant: 位於表面同基部之間嘅梨形細胞。

text.en: Small cuboidal cells on the basement membrane.
text.zh-Hant: 位於基底膜上嘅細小立方細胞。

text.en: Holds the DNA. Its shape and position follow the cell shape.
text.zh-Hant: 載有 DNA，形狀同位置跟隨細胞形狀。

text.en: Thin sheet under the cells that anchors the epithelium to the tissue below.
text.zh-Hant: 喺細胞下方嘅薄層，將上皮固定喺下面嘅組織。

summary.en: Cells scattered in an extracellular matrix of fibres and ground substance. Drawn here as loose connective tissue.
summary.zh-Hant: 細胞散佈於由纖維同基質組成嘅細胞外基質之中。圖中為疏鬆結締組織。

text.en: Gel-like material that fills the space between cells and fibres.
text.zh-Hant: 填滿細胞同纖維之間空間嘅膠狀物質。

text.en: Strong, rope-like fibres grouped into bundles. They resist pulling.
text.zh-Hant: 堅韌如繩嘅纖維，聚成纖維束，抵抗拉力。

text.en: Thin branching fibres that stretch and recoil.
text.zh-Hant: 幼細分支嘅纖維，可伸展及回彈。

text.en: Fine fibres forming a supporting mesh around cells and vessels.
text.zh-Hant: 幼細纖維，喺細胞同血管周圍形成支持網。

text.en: Flat, spindle-shaped cell that makes the fibres and ground substance.
text.zh-Hant: 扁平梭形細胞，製造纖維同基質。

text.en: Engulfs debris and microbes.
text.zh-Hant: 吞噬碎屑同微生物。

text.en: Makes antibodies.
text.zh-Hant: 製造抗體。

text.en: Store lipid in one large droplet.
text.zh-Hant: 以一個大脂滴貯存脂質。

text.en: Brings nutrients and takes away waste.
text.zh-Hant: 運送養分及帶走廢物。

text.en: Carries signals to and from the tissue.
text.zh-Hant: 向組織傳入及傳出訊號。

summary.en: Cells specialised to contract. The three types are skeletal, cardiac and smooth muscle.
summary.zh-Hant: 專門收縮嘅細胞。三種類型為骨骼肌、心肌同平滑肌。

text.en: Long, cylindrical, striated fibres with many nuclei pushed to the edge. Voluntary control.
text.zh-Hant: 長圓柱形有橫紋嘅肌纖維，多個細胞核靠近邊緣。受意識控制。

text.en: Striated, branched fibres with one central nucleus. Dark intercalated discs join the cells end to end. Involuntary.
text.zh-Hant: 有橫紋、有分支，一個中央細胞核。深色嘅閏盤將細胞首尾相連。不受意識控制。

text.en: Short spindle-shaped cells with one central nucleus and no striations. Found in walls of hollow organs and vessels. Involuntary.
text.zh-Hant: 短梭形細胞，一個中央細胞核，冇橫紋。見於空腔器官同血管壁。不受意識控制。

summary.en: Neurons carry electrical signals and supporting glial cells insulate and protect them. Drawn here as one neuron with a myelinated axon.
summary.zh-Hant: 神經元傳遞電訊號，支持嘅神經膠質細胞負責絕緣同保護。圖中為一個有髓鞘軸突嘅神經元。

text.en: Contains the nucleus and most organelles of the neuron.
text.zh-Hant: 包含神經元嘅細胞核同大部分細胞器。

text.en: Holds the neuron's DNA.
text.zh-Hant: 載有神經元嘅 DNA。

text.en: Branched extensions that receive signals from other neurons.
text.zh-Hant: 分支狀突起，接收其他神經元嘅訊號。

text.en: Long extension that carries signals away from the cell body.
text.zh-Hant: 長突起，將訊號由細胞體傳出。

text.en: Insulating layers wrapped around the axon in segments. They speed up signal conduction.
text.zh-Hant: 分段包裹軸突嘅絕緣層，加快訊號傳導。

text.en: Gap between myelin segments where the axon is exposed and the signal is regenerated.
text.zh-Hant: 髓鞘分段之間嘅縫隙，軸突外露，訊號喺此再生。

text.en: Glial cell of the central nervous system. Its processes wrap axons in myelin.
text.zh-Hant: 中樞神經系統嘅膠質細胞，其突起以髓鞘包裹軸突。

text.en: Axon ends in bulbs that pass the signal to the next cell.
text.zh-Hant: 軸突末端膨大成球，將訊號傳給下一個細胞。

text.en: Carries signals toward the central nervous system (CNS). Sensory nerves are afferent.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號傳向中樞神經系統（CNS）。感覺神經屬傳入。

text.en: Carries signals away from the CNS to muscles or glands. Motor nerves are efferent.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號由中樞神經系統傳向肌肉或腺體。運動神經屬傳出。

note.en: In this neuron the signal passes from the dendrites to the cell body, then along the axon to the terminals.
note.zh-Hant: 喺呢個神經元，訊號由樹突傳到細胞體，再沿軸突傳到末端。

summary.en: Star-shaped glial cell of the central nervous system. Its processes support neurons, regulate the chemical surroundings and reach blood vessels with end-feet.
summary.zh-Hant: 中樞神經系統嘅星形膠質細胞。突起支持神經元、調節化學環境，並以終足接觸血管。

text.en: Holds the nucleus.
text.zh-Hant: 載有細胞核。

text.en: Branching arms that contact neurons and synapses.
text.zh-Hant: 分支嘅突起，接觸神經元同突觸。

text.en: Flattened ends on the blood vessel wall; they help form the blood–brain barrier.
text.zh-Hant: 貼喺血管壁上嘅扁平末端，協助形成血腦屏障。

text.en: Small blood vessel in the brain.
text.zh-Hant: 腦內嘅細小血管。

summary.en: Small immune cell of the central nervous system. Thin branched processes survey the tissue and the cell engulfs debris.
summary.zh-Hant: 中樞神經系統嘅細小免疫細胞。幼細分支突起巡視組織，並吞噬碎屑。

text.en: Small body with a dense nucleus.
text.zh-Hant: 細小嘅胞體，細胞核較致密。

text.en: Thin branches that continually probe the surroundings.
text.zh-Hant: 不斷探測周圍嘅幼細分支。

text.en: A damaged fragment being engulfed by phagocytosis.
text.zh-Hant: 正被吞噬嘅受損碎片。

summary.en: Ciliated cells lining the brain ventricles and the spinal central canal. Their cilia help move cerebrospinal fluid.
summary.zh-Hant: 襯住腦室同脊髓中央管嘅纖毛細胞。纖毛協助推動腦脊髓液。

text.en: Cuboidal to columnar cells in a single sheet.
text.zh-Hant: 排成單層嘅立方至柱狀細胞。

text.en: Beat to circulate cerebrospinal fluid.
text.zh-Hant: 擺動以推動腦脊髓液流動。

text.en: Ventricle or canal filled with cerebrospinal fluid.
text.zh-Hant: 充滿腦脊髓液嘅腦室或管道。

text.en: Holds the DNA. Its shape and position follow the cell shape.
text.zh-Hant: 載有 DNA，形狀同位置跟隨細胞形狀。

summary.en: Central nervous system cell that makes myelin. One cell sends processes to wrap segments of several axons.
summary.zh-Hant: 製造髓鞘嘅中樞神經系統細胞。一個細胞會伸出突起，包裹數條軸突嘅節段。

text.en: Holds the nucleus.
text.zh-Hant: 載有細胞核。

text.en: Each process flattens and wraps one axon segment.
text.zh-Hant: 每條突起會攤平並包裹一段軸突。

text.en: Insulating layers that speed up signal conduction.
text.zh-Hant: 絕緣層，加快訊號傳導。

text.en: Neuron fibres wrapped by the same oligodendrocyte.
text.zh-Hant: 由同一個寡突膠質細胞包裹嘅神經纖維。

summary.en: Flat glial cells of the peripheral nervous system that surround neuron cell bodies in ganglia and regulate their surroundings.
summary.zh-Hant: 周圍神經系統嘅扁平膠質細胞，圍住神經節內嘅神經元細胞體，並調節其周圍環境。

text.en: Neuron cell body with its nucleus.
text.zh-Hant: 神經元細胞體及其細胞核。

text.en: Flat cells forming a capsule around the cell body.
text.zh-Hant: 扁平細胞，圍成包住細胞體嘅囊。

summary.en: Peripheral nervous system cell that wraps one segment of one axon in myelin. Gaps between neighbours are the nodes of Ranvier.
summary.zh-Hant: 周圍神經系統細胞，以髓鞘包裹一條軸突嘅一個節段。相鄰細胞之間嘅空隙係蘭氏結。

text.en: Nerve fibre carrying the signal.
text.zh-Hant: 傳送訊號嘅神經纖維。

text.en: Many wraps of Schwann cell membrane.
text.zh-Hant: 許旺細胞膜嘅多重包裹層。

text.en: Cytoplasm pushed to the outside of the sheath.
text.zh-Hant: 被推到髓鞘外層嘅細胞質。

text.en: Lies on the outer surface of the sheath.
text.zh-Hant: 位於髓鞘外表面。

text.en: Bare axon between two Schwann cells; the signal jumps from node to node.
text.zh-Hant: 兩個許旺細胞之間裸露嘅軸突，訊號喺結與結之間跳躍傳導。

summary.en: Carries signals from a receptor toward the central nervous system. One stem leaves the cell body and splits into a peripheral and a central process.
summary.zh-Hant: 將訊號由感受器傳向中樞神經系統。一條主幹離開細胞體後分成周邊突同中樞突。

text.en: Sits in a ganglion, off to the side of the signal path.
text.zh-Hant: 位於神經節，偏離訊號路徑。

text.en: Brings the signal from the receptor to the cell body region.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號由感受器帶到細胞體附近。

text.en: Carries the signal into the spinal cord or brain.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號送入脊髓或腦。

text.en: Detects touch, stretch, temperature or pain.
text.zh-Hant: 偵測觸覺、拉伸、溫度或痛覺。

text.en: Pass the signal on to neurons in the central nervous system.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號傳給中樞神經系統內嘅神經元。

text.en: Carries signals toward the central nervous system (CNS). Sensory nerves are afferent.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號傳向中樞神經系統（CNS）。感覺神經屬傳入。

text.en: Carries signals away from the CNS to muscles or glands. Motor nerves are efferent.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號由中樞神經系統傳向肌肉或腺體。運動神經屬傳出。

note.en: In this neuron the signal passes from the dendrites to the cell body, then along the axon to the terminals.
note.zh-Hant: 喺呢個神經元，訊號由樹突傳到細胞體，再沿軸突傳到末端。

summary.en: Carries signals from the central nervous system to a muscle or gland. A multipolar cell with many dendrites and one long axon.
summary.zh-Hant: 將訊號由中樞神經系統傳向肌肉或腺體。多極細胞，有多條樹突同一條長軸突。

text.en: Receives input and holds the nucleus.
text.zh-Hant: 接收輸入並載有細胞核。

text.en: Branches that receive signals from other neurons.
text.zh-Hant: 接收其他神經元訊號嘅分支。

text.en: Long fibre carrying the signal away from the cell body.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號由細胞體傳走嘅長纖維。

text.en: Release neurotransmitter onto the muscle fibre.
text.zh-Hant: 向肌纖維釋放神經傳遞物質。

text.en: Target cell that contracts.
text.zh-Hant: 會收縮嘅目標細胞。

text.en: Carries signals toward the central nervous system (CNS). Sensory nerves are afferent.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號傳向中樞神經系統（CNS）。感覺神經屬傳入。

text.en: Carries signals away from the CNS to muscles or glands. Motor nerves are efferent.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號由中樞神經系統傳向肌肉或腺體。運動神經屬傳出。

note.en: In this neuron the signal passes from the dendrites to the cell body, then along the axon to the terminals.
note.zh-Hant: 喺呢個神經元，訊號由樹突傳到細胞體，再沿軸突傳到末端。

name.zh-Hant: 中間神經元（傳遞神經元）

summary.en: Connects neurons to neurons inside the central nervous system, linking sensory input to motor output. Multipolar, with a short axon.
summary.zh-Hant: 喺中樞神經系統內連接神經元，將感覺輸入連到運動輸出。多極，軸突較短。

text.en: Holds the nucleus and integrates incoming signals.
text.zh-Hant: 載有細胞核並整合傳入訊號。

text.en: Receive signals from sensory and other neurons.
text.zh-Hant: 接收感覺神經元同其他神經元嘅訊號。

text.en: Branches locally instead of leaving the central nervous system.
text.zh-Hant: 喺局部分支，唔離開中樞神經系統。

text.en: Pass the signal to the next neuron.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號傳給下一個神經元。

summary.en: A rod-shaped bacterium with no nucleus and no membrane-bound organelles. Schematic: no measured volume fractions yet.
summary.zh-Hant: 桿狀細菌，冇細胞核，亦冇膜包圍嘅細胞器。示意圖：暫時未有量度嘅體積比例。

text.en: Outer membrane, thin cell wall and inner membrane enclose the cell. Drawn as one translucent shell.
text.zh-Hant: 外膜、薄細胞壁同內膜包圍住細胞。圖中以一層半透明外殼表示。

text.en: Gel-like interior with no membrane-bound organelles. Metabolism and protein synthesis happen here.
text.zh-Hant: 膠狀內部，冇膜包圍嘅細胞器。代謝同蛋白質合成喺度進行。

text.en: The circular chromosome, folded into a tangle in a region with no nuclear envelope.
text.zh-Hant: 環狀染色體，摺疊成一團，所在區域冇核膜。

text.en: Small circular DNA rings separate from the chromosome. They often carry genes such as antibiotic resistance.
text.zh-Hant: 同染色體分開嘅小型環狀 DNA，常帶有例如抗生素抗藥性嘅基因。

text.en: Make proteins. Smaller than eukaryotic ribosomes, so some antibiotics block them without harming the host's own.
text.zh-Hant: 製造蛋白質。比真核生物嘅核糖體細，所以部分抗生素可阻斷佢哋而唔傷害宿主自己嘅核糖體。

text.en: Short surface hairs that attach the cell to surfaces and to other cells.
text.zh-Hant: 表面短毛，令細胞附著於表面或其他細胞。

text.en: Long helical filaments turned by a motor in the envelope. They push the cell through liquid.
text.zh-Hant: 長螺旋絲，由包膜上嘅馬達帶動旋轉，推動細胞喺液體中游動。

summary.en: A virus that infects bacteria. It is not a cell: it has no cytoplasm and cannot grow or divide on its own. Schematic with no data table.
summary.zh-Hant: 感染細菌嘅病毒。佢唔係細胞：冇細胞質，亦唔能獨立生長或分裂。示意圖，冇數據表。

text.en: Icosahedral protein shell that protects the genome.
text.zh-Hant: 二十面體蛋白質外殼，保護基因組。

text.en: Double-stranded DNA packed tightly inside the head. It is injected into the host bacterium during infection.
text.zh-Hant: 緊密包裝於頭部內嘅雙鏈 DNA，感染時注入宿主細菌。

text.en: Joins the head to the tail.
text.zh-Hant: 連接頭部同尾部。

text.en: Protein sleeve around the tail tube. It contracts to drive the tube through the host's envelope.
text.zh-Hant: 包住尾管嘅蛋白質套筒，收縮時將尾管推穿宿主嘅包膜。

text.en: Hollow core through which the DNA passes into the host.
text.zh-Hant: 中空嘅核心管道，DNA 經此進入宿主。

text.en: Hexagonal plate at the tail tip. It binds the host surface and triggers sheath contraction.
text.zh-Hant: 尾端嘅六角形板，結合宿主表面並觸發鞘收縮。

text.en: Short pins under the baseplate that anchor the phage to the host.
text.zh-Hant: 基板下方嘅短刺，將噬菌體固定於宿主。

text.en: Jointed fibres that recognise receptors on the host surface and hold the phage in place.
text.zh-Hant: 有關節嘅纖維，識別宿主表面嘅受體並將噬菌體固定。
